---
title: "Topics"
---

The site uses a small set of recurring topic categories so developments can be followed across issues.

## Climate & Earth-system models
Data-driven models, hybrid models, learned parameterizations, emulators, and model acceleration.

## Parameterizations
Convection, clouds, radiation, turbulence, ocean mixing, land processes, and learned closures.

## Prediction
Weather, subseasonal-to-seasonal, decadal prediction, initialized climate prediction, and developments that bridge weather and climate.

## Downscaling & regional climate
Statistical and generative downscaling, super-resolution, bias correction, and regional emulation.

## Extremes & impacts
Precipitation and heat extremes, tropical cyclones, compound events, risk distributions, and event generation.

## Observations & reanalysis
Remote sensing, reconstruction, data assimilation, gap filling, and representation learning from Earth observations.

## Scientific discovery
Interpretability, causal inference, equation and process discovery, representation analysis, and ML used to learn about the Earth system rather than only predict it.

## Methods
Foundation models, graph neural networks, transformers, generative models, probabilistic learning, uncertainty quantification, and other methodological developments with broad climate relevance.
